decisions.detail: Application snapshots correct overescaped decimal-dot patterns in documentation risk schemas, matching the prose decimal fields. Decimal90.50 validation test proves intended behavior; source docs generator needs reconciliation.
AJV strictRequired lint false only for legal then.required outer-object definitions; runtime required checks and strict schema/type/format validation remain active.
Only known exact synthetic PNG/PDF digests become clean_synthetic. Unknown valid bytes remain quarantined; EICAR/bad magic rejected. This is not a general malware-scanning service.

ST_CURSOR_SECRET binds signed cursors across replicas. Without configured secret, cryptographically random per-process local key safely invalidates cursors on restart; production shared-key deployment/rotation evidence pending.
